description: React component for a Giphy search dialog, allowing users to search or input Giphy URLs, display results, and handle user interactions.

methods.name: searchGiphy
methods.description: Performs a search request to Giphy API with a keyword and offset, updates state with the result or error.

methods.name: getGiphyByUrl
methods.description: Fetches a Giphy image by URL, updates state with the result or error.

methods.name: renderTab
methods.description: Renders a tab for switching between search modes.

methods.name: handleFormSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, triggers search or URL fetch based on selected mode.
